Question: Is this a sensor and what does it measure?
Answer: Yes; magnetic field on X Y and Z plus internal sensor temperature
Notes or evidence: Temperature is required for compensation and is also exposed as an RRIV output

Question: Does it need actuator behavior? Record as deferred work.
Answer: No actuator behavior
Notes or evidence: None planned

Question: How many physical quantities and how many output values?
Answer: Four output values: three magnetic axes and one temperature
Notes or evidence: Fixed output indices 0 through 3

Question: For each index: label unit range and raw/calibrated meaning
Answer: 0 mag_x uT compensated; 1 mag_y uT compensated; 2 mag_z uT compensated; 3 temperature degrees C compensated
Notes or evidence: Exact limits follow the BMM350 datasheet; raw register values are not exposed in the first scope

Question: Can the sensor be calibrated and will calibration be implemented?
Answer: Factory OTP compensation is required and will be applied; user field calibration is deferred
Notes or evidence: OTP coefficients will be loaded during setup

Question: Reference points and fitting method
Answer: No RRIV fit method in the first scope; later magnetic calibration would require hard-iron offsets and a soft-iron matrix
Notes or evidence: Reference equipment and procedure remain to be selected

Question: Protocol and required commands or features
Answer: I2C2 with combined write/read; soft reset; chip-ID read; OTP reads; magnetic reset; PMU configuration; one measurement burst
Notes or evidence: BMM350 I2C reads return two dummy bytes before data

Question: I2C address or ADC channel or other addressing
Answer: Default 0x14; alternate 0x15
Notes or evidence: Address is selected in special configuration

Question: GPIO and USART requirements
Answer: None
Notes or evidence: I2C-only driver keeps the default empty GPIO request

Question: PWM requirements and whether they imply deferred actuator work
Answer: None
Notes or evidence: No actuator work

Answer: None

Question: Initialization warmup conversion time and timeout
Answer: 3 ms before reset; 24 ms after reset; OTP polls every 300 us up to 100 attempts per word; 6 ms suspend; 14 ms bit reset; 18 ms flux reset; 1 ms config update; 38 ms normal-mode entry
Notes or evidence: All polling is bounded so a missing sensor returns an error

Notes or evidence: Recovery will require successful communication and setup; the logger must not hang

Notes or evidence: Fake-bus tests will cover dummy-byte removal and signed/OTP decoding
